title: Style obu.css for lecture notes/quizzes/handouts (readability + new elements)
description: Pass A (readability): h4-h6 size hierarchy, section heading top-margins, body/list line-height, font-weight fix, print widows/orphans + modern break-*, modern .page-break. Pass B (new element styles): callout boxes (.note/.tip/.warning/.example/.key-term), definition lists, .choices multiple-choice lists (lower-alpha), mark, kbd, task-list checkboxes. Built on top of the CSS custom properties from css-2da.
close_reason: Pass A (readability) + Pass B (callouts, definition lists, MC choices, mark/kbd, task lists) implemented in obu.css.

title: Extract OBU brand colors into CSS custom properties
description: OBU Green (#295b30) and OBU Gold (#c48b2b) are repeated as literal hex values throughout obu.css. Define them once as :root custom properties (--obu-green, --obu-gold, plus tints like the #faf8f3/#f7f3ea backgrounds) and reference via var(). Makes rebranding/tweaking a single-point change. Watch the @media print block and !important usage.
close_reason: Extracted brand + palette into :root custom properties; all values now reference var().

title: Add examples/sample.md demonstrating every obu.css class
description: Living reference + visual regression doc exercising all obu.css styles: heading hierarchy, callouts, definition lists, MC .choices, mark/kbd, task lists, code/syntax, tables, qa-block answer areas, page-break.
close_reason: Added examples/sample.md exercising every obu.css class; linked from README.

title: Add a general-purpose / website stylesheet
description: Repo is intended to also hold CSS for websites, not just Markdown→PDF. Add a web-facing OBU stylesheet. Unlike obu.css it should NOT rely on !important. Ideally share brand tokens with the Markdown sheet (depends on the custom-properties work).

title: Add stylelint config for CSS linting/formatting
description: No linting today. Add a stylelint config (e.g. stylelint-config-standard) to keep formatting consistent (2-space indent, lowercase hex, one selector per line) across stylesheets as the repo grows.
